scene: The plucked fruit glows brightly, revealing three bustling transit hubs.
picture: A rooftop terrace floor spans the base. On the left stands a gangway to a harbor ferry. The young Black woman in yellow raincoat, green boots, and red umbrella stands holding a bright glowing fruit at centre. Up high hangs a glass cable car, while a green street tram waits at the far right.
shown: a striped ferry gangway waiting at the dock edge on the left
a dangling glass gondola docked at an aerial cable station up high
a bell-ringing green street tram idling on rails at the far right
